BiblicalUsage: ʻelyôwn means the Supreme. Daniel calls God 'the most High' four times in chapter 7, where the saints of the most High take the kingdom.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: ʻelyôwn tells me that God is who He says He is, and His name carries everything He is. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
